strings.Give AI agents access to health data: 讓 AI 代理存取健康資料

strings.exclude private metrics from AI access: 排除私密指標，不讓 AI 存取
strings.explain why HRV changed recently: 說明 HRV 近期變化的原因
strings.install quantified-self-mcp via uv tool: 透過 uv tool install 安裝 quantified-self-mcp
strings.quantified-self-mcp --help blocks starti: quantified-self-mcp --help 會因啟動 FastMCP stdio 伺服器而卡住（逾時）－請改用 quantified-self-doctor 和 probe
strings.uv tool install quantified-self-mcp for: 使用 uv tool install quantified-self-mcp 進行隔離安裝以避開 PEP 668
